messages.subject: For Chuck Robbins | Digital infrastructure, public policy and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Cisco Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Chuck Robbins, Chief Executive Officer.

Cisco's role in digital infrastructure increasingly intersects with governments, public-sector modernization, regulation, cybersecurity and responsible technology. That stakeholder environment aligns closely with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and translate external priorities into accountable internal action across multiple functions.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, global stakeholder strategy and emerging-market operating experience might support Cisco's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Cisco.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
